title: PiD is not deprecated - it stays as a model that brings its four upscale plugins
description: UMBRELLA: MPI-732. Reverses MPI-515. PiD keeps its ModelDef and Library card; installing it activates all four plugins (shared requiredDeps, the Krea2 + image-describer shape). Carries an unsolved design problem: uninstalling one plugin makes PiD read uninstalled. See plan.md.
